name: register_rss_to_watcher
description: Start watching a podcast for new episodes by registering its RSS or Atom feed URL (find the official feed first; see the register-watcher-on-podcast skill). The backend fetches and validates the feed before saving it. Its newest episode is then ingested within minutes, and the feed is checked hourly for later episodes; older episodes are not ingested. Returns status 'registered' (with the podcast and its newest episode), 'already_registered', or 'invalid' (with the reason). The watched feeds are in the watch_sources table.

feed_url.description: The podcast's RSS or Atom feed URL (http or https), not its web page.
